title: Desert animals
examples: How do animals survive when it is very hot in the desert?
What do lizards eat in the desert?
Can scorpions survive in the desert?

explain.say: Today we learn about animals that live in the desert.
Camels are very famous for living in hot deserts.
Lizards are small reptiles that can change color.
Scorpions have a tail with a stinging part.
All these animals have ways to stay cool.
When it is very hot, animals often drink water stored in their bodies.

faq.q: Do all desert animals need to drink water?
faq.a: Some desert animals can get water from their food. They also store water in their bodies to survive.
asks: Where do desert animals get water?
Can they live without drinking water?

faq.q: What is the camel's hump for?
faq.a: The hump helps camels store fat. This fat gives them energy when food is scarce.
Lizards change color to hide from other animals. This helps them stay safe from predators.
Scorpions have stingers that can sting. It is important to look at them from far away.
asks: What should I do near scorpions?

faq.q: Do all desert animals sleep during the day?
faq.a: Many animals rest during the hottest part of the day. They wait until it is cooler to move around.
asks: Is it always hot in the desert?

facts: Camels can go for a long time without finding water.
Lizards use color changes to blend into their surroundings.
Scorpions are nocturnal, meaning they are active at night.
Many desert animals can survive on very little food.

quiz.say: Which animal stores fat in its hump?
quiz.why: Camels use their humps to store fat for energy.

wrong.0: Lizards change color to hide, not store fat.
wrong.1: Scorpions use their stingers for defense.
wrong.2: Elephants live in different types of habitats.

quiz.say: What is the main purpose of a lizard changing color?
quiz.why: Changing color helps the lizard blend in with the background.

wrong.1: Warning is usually done with bright colors.
wrong.2: Showing off is not a survival skill.
wrong.3: They change color for camouflage, not heat.

quiz.show: The sun is at its strongest

options.show: The hottest part of the day
options.say: The hottest part of the day

quiz.why: Resting during the hottest time helps them save energy and stay cool.

wrong.1: Some animals are active at night.
wrong.2: Rain is not always in the desert.
wrong.3: The moon does not control their resting time.
